# Thunderbird Update direction recovery and Calendar implementation conventions

To recover actual Update directions, inspect `~/.tb-tools/patch-sessions/*`, select `data.chat` entries for `mode == freeform`, and retain user-role messages only; broad thread listings and generic memory search were noisy/truncated. [Task 1]

Scope: calendar.
